concerns.text: T027 (Re-Generate Preprocessed Data) is marked [ ] (pending) but is a hard producer for T032 (Feature Engineering), T037 (Model Metrics), and T028 (Completeness Report). T032 explicitly depends on T027's output (`data/processed/alloys_raw.csv`). The pipeline cannot execute US2 or US3 until T027 is completed. This is a critical producer-before-consumer violation blocking the entire downstream flow.

T032 (Feature Engineering Pipeline) is marked [ ] (pending) and depends on T027. Since T027 is pending, T032 cannot execute. Furthermore, T032 is a producer for T035 (Training Pipeline) and T037 (Model Metrics). The dependency chain T027 -> T032 -> T035/T037 is broken at the source.

Tasks T028b-1, T028b-2, and T028b-3 (Scarcity Check) are marked [ ] (pending). T046 (Data Scarcity Warning) depends on T028b-3. T032 (Feature Engineering) and T037 (Model Metrics) list T028b-3 as a dependency. If these tasks are not executed, the scarcity warning (FR-008) will not be generated, and downstream tasks may proceed without the required validation flag, violating the spec's edge case handling.

Tasks T066, T067, T068, and T069 are marked [ ] (pending). T067 (Strict Real Data Fetch Enforcement) is a prerequisite for T016/T017 logic to be safe (preventing silent fallbacks). T068 (Microstructure-Adjusted Features) is a producer for T035/T036. T069 (Physical Plausibility) is a producer for T050. Their pending status breaks the logical flow for robust data ingestion and advanced feature engineering required by the spec's scientific context.

T024b (Imputation Strategy Rationale) lists T061 as a dependency, but T061 (Plan Amendment) is described as a prerequisite to T024b in the 'Critical' notes. This creates a circular dependency description (T024b -> T061 -> T024b) which is confusing for execution ordering, even if the logical intent (amend plan before documenting rationale) is clear.
